canDoYue: 你識喺外國租車：出示駕駛執照同國際許可證，問九百蚊自付額，滿箱取滿箱還，星期五六點還車，同寫低後門刮痕。
canDoEn: Rent a car with a driving licence and an international permit, ask about a nine-hundred-dollar excess, accept full-to-full fuel, return it by six on Friday, and note a scratch on the rear door.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Hi. I'd like to rent a car. Here is my driving licence.
dialogue.glossYue: 你好。我想租車。呢張係我嘅駕駛執照。
dialogue.say: Hi. I'd like to rent a car. Here is my driving licence.

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Thanks. Do you also have an international permit?
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝。你有冇國際駕駛許可證？
dialogue.say: Thanks. Do you also have an international permit?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Yes, I do. What is the insurance excess on this car?
dialogue.glossYue: 有。呢架車嘅保險自付額係幾多？
dialogue.say: Yes, I do. What is the insurance excess on this car?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: The excess is nine hundred dollars. Fuel is full to full.
dialogue.glossYue: 自付額係九百蚊。油要滿箱取、滿箱還。
dialogue.say: The excess is nine hundred dollars. Fuel is full to full.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Full to full is fine. What time do I need to return it?
dialogue.glossYue: 滿箱還可以。我要幾時還車？
dialogue.say: Full to full is fine. What time do I need to return it?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Please return it by six on Friday. We check every car at the desk.
dialogue.glossYue: 請星期五六點之前還。我哋會喺櫃檯檢查每一架車。
dialogue.say: Please return it by six on Friday. We check every car at the desk.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: There is one scratch on the rear door. Can you note that?
dialogue.glossYue: 後門有一條刮痕。可唔可以寫低？
dialogue.say: There is one scratch on the rear door. Can you note that?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Yes. I've marked that scratch, and the rental fee stays the same.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。我寫低咗條刮痕，租金維持不變。
dialogue.say: Yes. I've marked that scratch, and the rental fee stays the same.
